dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, your English test is on Friday, isn't it?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, jʊr ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˌtɛst ɪz ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ, ˈɪzənt ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. I wish it were Friday today! I just want it to be over.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. aɪ ˈwɪʃ ɪt wɜːr ˈfraɪdeɪ təˈdeɪ! aɪ ˈdʒʌst ˈwɑːnt ɪt tə bi ˈoʊvər.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I hope you pass. You need the certificate for Toronto, right?
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈhoʊp juː ˈpæs. juː ˈniːd ðə sərˈtɪfɪkət fər təˈrɑːntoʊ, ˈraɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, but I'm not very hopeful. The speaking part is really hard.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, bʌt aɪm ˈnɑːt ˈvɛri ˈhoʊpfəl. ðə ˈspiːkɪŋ ˌpɑːrt ɪz ˈriːli ˈhɑːrd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Don't be so pessimistic! Your English is great.
dialogue.reading: ˈdoʊnt bi ˈsoʊ ˌpɛsəˈmɪstɪk! jʊr ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ɪz ˈɡreɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'm not pessimistic. I'm just being realistic.
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈnɑːt ˌpɛsəˈmɪstɪk. aɪm ˈdʒʌst ˈbiːɪŋ ˌriːəˈlɪstɪk.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Well, I'm optimistic. I think your dream of studying in Toronto will come true.
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛl, aɪm ˌɑːptəˈmɪstɪk. aɪ ˈθɪŋk jʊr ˈdriːm əv ˈstʌdiɪŋ ɪn təˈrɑːntoʊ wɪl ˈkʌm ˈtruː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I hope so. If I pass, you can come and visit me in Toronto!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈhoʊp ˈsoʊ. ɪf aɪ ˈpæs, juː kən ˈkʌm ənd ˈvɪzɪt miː ɪn təˈrɑːntoʊ!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Fingers crossed. And I hope your flight home goes well.
dialogue.reading: ˈfɪŋɡərz ˈkrɔːst. ənd aɪ ˈhoʊp jʊr ˈflaɪt ˈhoʊm ˈɡoʊz ˈwɛl.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Thanks. I just wish I didn't have to say goodbye.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks. aɪ ˈdʒʌst ˈwɪʃ aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈhæf tə ˈseɪ ɡʊdˈbaɪ.
